source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: the Chapter 5 exercise solved (PDF 141-142), MCQ keys worked out from the chapter.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 5 (Enzymes) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai (kitab MCQs ki key nahi deti); short, long aur inquisitive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) diye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Section 1: Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt: 1. What roles does nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide play in oxidative pathways?
blocks.explanation: NAD⁺ ghair-protein organic molecule hai jo enzyme se dheela jura hota hai; yeh sab se aham coenzyme hai jo oxidation mein khurak se hydrogen (electrons) le kar NADH ban jata hai (5.2).

blocks.prompt: 2. The enzymes that catalyse the reactions in which two molecules are joined together by synthesis of new bonds, using energy from ATP, are placed in group;
blocks.explanation: Ligases ATP ki energy se naye C-C, C-N, C-O ya C-S bonds bana kar do molecules jorte hain, maslan polymerases (5.7).

blocks.prompt: 3. Which of the following is an example of hydrolases?
blocks.explanation: Lipase pani daal kar (hydrolysis) lipids torta hai, is liye hydrolase hai. Pyruvate decarboxylase lyase (CO₂ nikalta hai), cytochrome oxidase oxidoreductase hai, aur glycogen phosphorylase (chapter se aage) phosphate istemal karne wala transferase hai, pani nahi.

blocks.prompt: 4. Which of the following statements about enzymes is correct?

options.text: They increase the activation energy of a reaction.
They are consumed during the reaction.
They are specific in terms of the reactions they catalyse.
They always work optimally at high temperatures.

blocks.explanation: Har enzyme ki active site makhsoos hoti hai, is liye woh sirf makhsoos substrate aur reaction par kaam karta hai. Enzymes activation energy kam karte hain (barhate nahi), aakhir mein waise hi rehte hain, aur zyada garmi mein denature ho jate hain.

blocks.prompt: 5. Enzyme B requires Zn2+ to catalyse the conversion of substrate X. The zinc is best identified as a(n):
blocks.explanation: Zn²⁺ metal ion cofactor hai: yeh ghair-faal (non-functional) active site ko faal (functional) bana deta hai (5.2). Aise inorganic ion cofactors ko activators kehte hain. Coenzyme organic molecule hota hai, aur zinc na badalta hai (substrate) na banta hai (product).

blocks.prompt: 6. If an enzyme solution is saturated with substrate, the most effective way to obtain an even faster yield of products would be
blocks.explanation: Saturation par saari active sites bhari hoti hain, is liye mazeed substrate se rate nahi barhta. Mazeed enzyme se nayi active sites milti hain aur rate barhta hai (5.4). Inhibitors to reaction ko dheema karte hain.

blocks.prompt: 7. How does a non-competitive inhibitor decrease the rate of an enzyme-catalysed reaction?

options.text: By binding the active site of the enzyme
By changing the shape of the enzyme
By changing the free energy change of the reaction
By acting as a coenzyme for the reaction

blocks.explanation: Non-competitive inhibitor active site mein nahi jata; enzyme ki kisi aur jagah jur kar us ki shakal badal deta hai, phir active site substrate par fit nahi hoti (5.6). Active site par jurna competitive inhibition hai.

blocks.prompt: 8. Which enzyme class is responsible for catalysing the addition of water to a substrate molecule?
blocks.explanation: Hydrolases hydrolysis karwate hain: pani daal kar substrate ko torte hain (5.7). Lyases groups ko baghair hydrolysis ke jorte ya nikalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
1. Define enzyme and co-factor.
Enzyme aur co-factor ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation:
Enzyme: makhsoos protein jo activation energy kam kar ke kisi makhsoos chemical reaction ko tez karta hai aur khud nahi badalta (biocatalyst).
Co-factor: enzyme ke saath lagne wala ghair-protein hissa jo catalysis ke liye zaroori ho, maslan metal ions (Mg²⁺, Zn²⁺), prosthetic groups aur coenzymes (NAD⁺).

blocks.prompt:
2. Differentiate between co-enzyme and prosthetic group.
Co-enzyme aur prosthetic group mein farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Dono ghair-protein cofactors hain; prosthetic group mazbooti se (covalent) jura hota hai, coenzyme dheela.

rows: Ghair-protein organic molecule jo enzyme se dheela jura ho
Cofactor jo enzyme se covalent bond se jura ho
Alag ho kar aik enzyme se doosre tak electrons (hydrogen) le jata hai
Hamesha enzyme se jura rehta hai
Aksar vitamins ya un se bane (niacin, riboflavin)
Organic compound ho sakta hai
Misal: NAD⁺
Misal: hematin

blocks.prompt:
3. What do you mean by hydrolases? Give two examples.
Hydrolases se kya muraad hai? Do misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Hydrolases woh enzymes hain jo hydrolysis karwate hain: pani daal kar substrate ko monomers mein torte hain.
Misalein: lipase (lipids → fatty acids aur glycerol) aur amylase (starch → maltose); peptidase aur doosre digestive enzymes bhi.

blocks.prompt:
4. What is meant by activation energy?
Activation energy se kya muraad hai?
blocks.explanation:
Activation energy woh energy hai jo kisi chemical reaction ko shuru karne ke liye chahiye; yeh reactants ke maujooda bonds ko kamzor (destabilize) karti hai.
Reaction ki raftaar is par munhasir hai; enzymes activation energy kam karte hain, is liye reaction tez hoti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Define feedback inhibition.
Feedback inhibition ki tareef karein.
blocks.explanation:
Feedback inhibition: metabolic pathway ka aakhri product usi pathway ke shuru wale enzyme ko rok deta hai; enzyme ki shakal badal jati hai, pathway band ho jata hai aur mazeed product nahi banta.
Misal: ATP zyada ho to ATP banane wala enzyme ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
6. Give examples of competitive and non-competitive inhibitors.
Competitive aur non-competitive inhibitors ki misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Competitive: malonic acid (malonate) succinic dehydrogenase ki active site ke liye succinic acid se muqabla karta hai; bacteria ke enzymes rokne wali antibiotics.
Non-competitive: succinyl-CoA succinyl-CoA synthetase ko rokta hai; zyada ATP ATP banane wale enzyme ko rokta hai.

blocks.prompt:
7. What is optimum pH? Give optimum pH of three human enzymes.
Optimum pH kya hai? Teen insani enzymes ka optimum pH bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Optimum pH woh khaas pH hai jis par enzyme sab se tez kaam karta hai.
Misalein: pepsin 1.5-1.6; salivary amylase 4.6-5.2; trypsin 7.8-8.7 (pancreatic lipase 8.0 bhi).

blocks.prompt:
1. Describe the structure of enzyme, explaining the role and component parts of the active site of an enzyme.
Enzyme ki structure bayan karein aur active site ke hisse aur kaam samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Enzyme ki structure:
- Enzymes 3D globular (gol) proteins hain jo apne aap par lipti polypeptide chains se bane hain; sab ribosomes par bante hain.
- Bohat se enzymes ko ghair-protein cofactor (metal ion, prosthetic group ya coenzyme) chahiye. Protein wala hissa apoenzyme; apoenzyme + cofactor = holoenzyme.
Active site:
- Enzyme ki satah par chhota sa gadha (cleft) jo sirf chand amino acids se bana hai; yahin catalysis hota hai.
- Is ki shakal bohat makhsoos, 3D aur makhsoos charge wali hoti hai, is liye sirf khaas substrate is mein fit hota hai (specificity).
Active site ke hisse:
1. Binding site: substrate is mein fit hota hai aur kamzor chemical forces (jaise hydrogen bonds) se pakra jata hai.
2. Catalytic site: reaction karwati hai; is ke atoms substrate ke khaas bonds par dabao daal kar unhein kamzor karte hain, activation energy kam hoti hai aur substrate products mein badal jata hai.
Kaam: substrate active site se jur kar enzyme-substrate complex banata hai (E + S → ES → E + P); reaction ke baad products alag ho jate hain aur enzyme baghair badle agle substrate ke liye tayyar hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
2. Differentiate among the three types of co-factors, by giving examples.
Co-factors ki teen qismon mein misalon ke saath farq bataein.
blocks.explanation: Cofactors ghair-protein hisse hain jo enzymes ko catalysis mein madad dete hain. Cofactor ke baghair protein wala hissa (apoenzyme) kaam nahi karta; cofactor ke saath poora enzyme holoenzyme kehlata hai. Is ki teen qismein hain:

rows: Inorganic metal ions
Aam taur par organic compounds
Ghair-protein organic molecules
Enzyme se jur kar ghair-faal active site ko faal banate hain; enzyme ki shakal badalte hain taake substrate jur sake
Covalent bonds se enzyme se mustaqil jure hote hain
Dheele jure; aik enzyme se doosre tak ja sakte hain
Active site ko kaam ke qabil banate hain
Enzyme par reh kar catalysis mein hissa lete hain
Aksar enzymes ke darmiyan electrons (hydrogen) le jate hain; aksar vitamins ya un se bane
Misalein: Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺, Mn²⁺, Cu²⁺, Zn²⁺; trace elements molybdenum, manganese
Misal: hematin
Misalein: NAD⁺ (NADH banta hai), niacin, riboflavin

blocks.prompt:
3. Explain the mechanism of enzyme action through Induced Fit Model, comparing it with Lock and Key Model.
Induced Fit Model ke zariye enzyme ke amal ka tareeqa samjhayein aur Lock and Key Model se muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation:
Tareeqa: substrate active site se jur kar enzyme-substrate (ES) complex banata hai; catalytic site substrate ke bonds par dabao daal kar unhein kamzor karti hai, activation energy kam hoti hai; substrate products mein badalta hai jo alag ho jate hain aur enzyme waisa hi rehta hai: E + S → ES → E + P.
Induced Fit Model (Daniel Koshland, 1958): jab substrate binding site se jurta hai to enzyme ki structure mein tabdeeli lata (induce karta) hai; active site lachakdar (flexible) hai aur catalysis se pehle substrate ke gird apni shakal dhaal leti hai, is se enzyme behtar kaam karta hai. Muqabla:

rows: Daniel Koshland ne pesh kiya (1958)
Emil Fischer ne pesh kiya (1894)
Active site lachakdar (flexible) hai
Active site sakht (rigid) hai
Substrate active site ki shakal badal deta hai taake theek fit ho
Substrate active site mein bilkul fit hota hai jaise chaabi taale mein; shakal nahi badalti
Tabdeeli catalysis shuru hone se pehle hoti hai
Amal se pehle, dauran ya baad koi tabdeeli nahi
Zyada tar reactions ko wazeh karta hai; nayi shahadat par mabni
Baad ki tehqeeq ne har reaction mein is ki tasdeeq nahi ki

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Lock and key: chaabi aur taala dono sakht. Induced fit: dastana (glove) aur haath: dastana haath daalne par haath ki shakal le leta hai; isi tarah active site substrate aane par us ke mutabiq dhal jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
4. Define activation energy and explain through graph how an enzyme speeds up a reaction by lowering activation energy.
Activation energy ki tareef karein aur graph ke zariye wazeh karein ke enzyme activation energy kam kar ke reaction kaise tez karta hai.
blocks.explanation:
Activation energy: kisi chemical reaction ko shuru karne ke liye zaroori energy; yeh reactants ke maujooda bonds ko kamzor karti hai. Reaction ki raftaar is baat par munhasir hai ke kitni activation energy chahiye.
Graph (bana kar labels lagayein):
- X-axis: reaction ki pesh-raft (progress); Y-axis: energy (free energy).
- Baen taraf reactants (substrate) ki satah, daen taraf products ki neechi satah.
- Reactants se products tak aik ooncha ubhaar (curve) banayein, label "enzyme ke baghair reaction"; reactants se is ki oonchai ko "enzyme ke baghair activation energy" likhein.
- Inhi do satahon ke darmiyan aik neecha ubhaar banayein, label "enzyme ke saath reaction"; is ki kam oonchai ko "enzyme ke saath activation energy" likhein.
- Reactants aur products ki energy ka farq dono mein aik jaisa hai.
Wazahat:
- Enzyme enzyme-substrate complex banata hai; reactants ko sahi rukh mein qareeb lata hai aur khaas bonds par dabao dalta hai, is liye unhein torne mein kam energy lagti hai.
- Energy ki rukawat kam ho to jism ke temperature par bohat zyada molecules react kar lete hain, is liye reaction 10³ se 10⁸ guna tez hoti hai (jo reaction enzyme se 30 minute mein ho, enzyme ke baghair aik saal leti).
- Enzyme products ki nature nahi badalta (sucrose se hamesha glucose aur fructose) aur khud bhi nahi badalta.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: pahari (hump) paar kar ke doosri taraf jana hai. Enzyme pahari ki oonchai kam kar deta hai, is liye zyada log (molecules) jaldi paar kar lete hain; manzil (products) wahi rehti hai.

blocks.prompt:
5. Describe the effect of temperature on the rate of enzyme action.
Enzyme ke amal ki raftaar par temperature ka asar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Enzyme ki shakal hydrogen bonds aur hydrophobic interactions se qaim hai jo temperature se aasani se mutasir hote hain. Har enzyme aik khaas temperature par sab se tez kaam karta hai jise optimum temperature kehte hain (insani enzymes ka 37 °C).
1. Optimum se kam: enzyme ki shakal tay karne wale bonds kam lachakdar ho jate hain aur active site mein zaroori tabdeeli (induced change) nahi hone dete, is liye reaction dheemi.
2. Optimum tak barhna: garmi activation energy mein izafa karti hai aur enzyme aur substrate ko kinetic energy (harkat ki energy) deti hai; woh tez chalte aur zyada takraate hain, is liye rate optimum tak barhta hai.
3. Optimum se zyada: garmi enzyme ke atoms ki thar-tharahat barha deti hai; jab yeh bohat shadeed ho to bonds polypeptide chains ko nahi sambhal pate, globular shakal khatam ho jati hai (denaturation) aur rate tezi se girta ya bilkul ruk jata hai.
Graph: rate temperature ke saath barh kar optimum par chotti tak jata hai, phir tezi se girta hai.
Misal: garam chashmon ke thermophilic bacteria ke enzymes mazboot bonds wale hain aur 70 °C ya zyada par kaam karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
6. Compare the optimum temperatures of enzymes of human and thermophilic bacteria.
Insan aur thermophilic bacteria ke enzymes ke optimum temperatures ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation: Insani enzymes jism ke temperature par behtareen kaam karte hain; thermophilic bacteria ke enzymes is se kahin zyada temperature par, kyunke un ke proteins ke bonds zyada mazboot hain.

rows: Optimum temperature taqreeban 37 °C (jism ka temperature)
Optimum temperature 70 °C ya zyada
Polypeptide chains ko jorne wale bonds kamzor
Polypeptide arms ke darmiyan mazboot bonds
37 °C se kafi zyada par denature (tez bukhar nuqsan deh)
Zyada temperature par bhi qaim aur faal
Insani jism mein kaam karte hain
Garam chashmon ke bacteria mein kaam karte hain

blocks.prompt:
7. Describe how the concentration of enzyme affects the rate of enzyme action.
Bataein ke enzyme ki concentration enzyme ke amal ki raftaar ko kaise mutasir karti hai.
blocks.explanation:
Enzymes bohat kaar-amad hain; thore se enzyme molecules bohat zyada substrate par kaam kar lete hain.
- Agar substrate be-hisaab ho to reaction ka rate seedha enzyme ki miqdaar par munhasir hai.
- Enzyme ki concentration barhe to zyada enzyme molecules aur zyada active sites milti hain, zyada substrate molecules jur kar products bante hain: rate barhta hai.
- Agar enzyme barhta rahe magar substrate utna hi rahe to jurne ke liye mazeed substrate nahi bachta, is liye rate mustaqil (constant) ho jata hai aur nahi barhta (ab substrate hadd (limiting factor) ban jata hai).
Graph (Fig. 5.7): rate enzyme concentration ke saath seedhi lakeer mein barhta hai phir hamwar (plateau) ho jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
8. Explain the effect of substrate concentration on the rate of enzyme action.
Enzyme ke amal ki raftaar par substrate concentration ka asar samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Enzyme ki concentration mustaqil rakh kar:
- Kam substrate par bohat si active sites khali hoti hain; naye substrate molecules khali active sites se jurte hain aur diye gaye waqt mein zyada products bante hain, is liye substrate barhane se rate barhta hai.
- Substrate mazeed barhayein to aik waqt aata hai jab saari active sites bhar jati hain (enzyme saturated ho jata hai).
- Is ke baad zaid substrate molecules ko khali active site nahi milti, is liye rate mazeed nahi barhta aur apni intehai hadd par rehta hai.
Graph (Fig. 5.8): rate pehle tezi se barhta hai, phir mur kar zyada substrate par hamwar (plateau) ho jata hai. Saturation par sirf enzyme barhane se rate barh sakta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: aik bank mein 5 counters (active sites) hain. Gahak (substrate) kam hon to har naya gahak foran counter par jata hai aur kaam tez hota hai. Jab paanchon counters masroof hon to mazeed gahak aane se kaam ki raftaar nahi barhti; counters (enzyme) barhane se hi barhegi.

blocks.prompt:
9. Describe enzymatic inhibition, its types and its significance.
Enzymatic inhibition, is ki qismein aur ahmiyat bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Enzyme inhibition: inhibitor woh chemical hai jo enzyme ke kaam mein dakhal de kar use rok de. Inhibitors enzyme se jurte hain magar products nahi bante, aur active site ko thori der ya hamesha ke liye band kar dete hain. Pechida pathways ke aakhri products bhi pehle enzyme ko rok sakte hain.
Qismein:
1. Competitive inhibitors substrate jaise hote hain aur usi active (binding) site ke liye muqabla karte hain; chun liye jayen to site band kar dete hain, maslan malonic acid succinic dehydrogenase ke liye succinic acid se muqabla karta hai.
2. Non-competitive inhibitors substrate jaise nahi hote; enzyme ki kisi aur jagah jur kar us ki shakal badal dete hain, phir active site substrate par fit nahi hoti, maslan succinyl-CoA succinyl-CoA synthetase ko rokta hai.
3. Irreversible (na palatne wale) inhibitors enzyme se covalent bond banate hain; dilution, dialysis ya zyada substrate se nahi hat-te, maslan penicillin bacteria ki cell wall banane wala enzyme hamesha ke liye nakara kar deta hai; cyanide cytochrome oxidase ko rokta hai.
4. Reversible (palatne wale) inhibitors kamzor bonds (hydrogen bonds) banate hain; inhein hata kar ya substrate barha kar asar khatam hota hai, maslan malonate.
Ahmiyat:
- Reactions ka rate control kar ke metabolic pathways ko qaabu mein rakhti hai (feedback inhibition samet).
- Bohat si dawaiyan inhibitors hain: antibiotics bacteria ke enzymes rokti hain; cancer ki dawaiyan cell division ke enzymes; aspirin prostaglandin banane wale enzymes rok kar dard aur soojan kam karti hai.
- Khoon jamne ke enzymes ke inhibitors anticoagulants (khoon patla rakhne wali dawa) ke taur par.
- Zehar enzymes ko kaise rokte hain, yeh jaan kar zehar ka ilaaj.
- Dawa saazi ki tehqeeq aur enzyme kinetics ke mutale mein madadgar.

blocks.prompt:
10. Categorize inhibitors into competitive and non-competitive inhibitors.
Inhibitors ko competitive aur non-competitive mein taqseem karein.
blocks.explanation: Inhibitors ki do aam qismein hain: competitive inhibitors active site ke liye substrate se larte hain, non-competitive kisi aur jagah jur kar enzyme ki shakal badalte hain.

rows: Banawat mein substrate jaise
Substrate se koi asal mushabehat nahi
Usi binding (active) site ke liye substrate se muqabla
Active site mein nahi jate; enzyme ki kisi aur jagah jurte hain
Active site band kar dete hain, substrate jur nahi pata
Enzyme ki shakal badal dete hain, active site substrate par fit nahi hoti
Substrate barhane se asar kam hota hai (reversible hon to)
Zyada substrate se asar khatam nahi hota
Misal: malonic acid (succinic dehydrogenase par); bacteria ke enzymes rokne wali antibiotics
Misal: succinyl-CoA (succinyl-CoA synthetase par); feedback inhibition mein ATP

blocks.prompt:
11. Explain feedback inhibition.
Feedback inhibition samjhayein.
blocks.explanation:
Metabolic pathway mein kai enzymes silsilewar kaam karte hain: aik reaction ka product agli ka substrate banta hai aur aakhir mein matloob product banta hai.
- Is product ki miqdaar qaabu mein rakhne ke liye, kafi product ban jaye to pathway band hona chahiye.
- Feedback inhibition mein pathway ka aakhri product inhibitor ka kaam karta hai: pathway ke shuru wale enzyme se (active site ke ilawa jagah par) jur kar us ki shakal (conformation) badal deta hai.
- Enzyme ab apne substrate se nahi jur sakta, pathway band ho jata hai aur mazeed product nahi banta.
- Jab product istemal ho jaye to rukawat hat jati hai aur pathway phir chalta hai; yun product apni paidawar khud control karta hai.
Misal: jab cell mein zaroorat se zyada ATP ho to ATP non-competitive inhibitor ban kar ATP banane wale enzyme ko rok deta hai.
Pathway ka khaka (Fig. 5.11): A → B → C → D (aakhri product), aur D se pehle enzyme (A → B) ki taraf wapas teer, us par "inhibition" likhein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Misal: paani ki tanki mein float valve. Tanki bhar jaye (product zyada) to valve pani (pathway) band kar deta hai; pani kam ho to phir khol deta hai.

blocks.prompt:
12. Classify enzymes on the basis of the reactions catalysed.
Enzymes ko un ki karwai jane wali reactions ki bunyad par classify karein.
blocks.explanation:
Reaction ki qisam ke lehaz se enzymes chhe classes mein hain:
1. Oxidoreductases: substrates ki oxidation/reduction; H⁺ ions ya electrons jorte ya nikalte hain. Misal: cytochrome oxidase cytochrome ko oxidize karta hai.
2. Transferases: aik makhsoos functional group (methyl, acyl, amino ya phosphate) aik substrate se doosre ko muntaqil karte hain. Misal: hexokinase ATP se phosphate glucose ko deta hai.
3. Hydrolases: hydrolysis; pani daal kar substrate ko monomers mein torte hain. Misal: lipase, amylase, peptidase aur doosre digestive enzymes.
4. Lyases: baghair hydrolysis ke groups (CO₂, NH₂ waghera) jorte ya nikalte hain. Misal: pyruvate decarboxylase pyruvic acid se CO₂ nikalta hai.
5. Isomerases: molecule ke andar tarteeb badal kar aik isomer ko doosre mein badalte hain. Misal: hexose isomerase glucose ko fructose banata hai.
6. Ligases: ATP ki energy se naye C-C, C-N, C-O ya C-S bonds bana kar do molecules jorte hain. Misal: polymerases ATP se monomers jorte hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Chhe classes yaad karne ka jumla: "O T H L I L" — Oxidoreductase, Transferase, Hydrolase, Lyase, Isomerase, Ligase.

blocks.prompt:
13. Give examples of enzymes' naming according to substrates.
Substrates ke mutabiq enzymes ke naam rakhne ki misalein dein.
blocks.explanation:
Bohat se enzymes ka naam us substrate par rakha jata hai jis par woh kaam karte hain, aam taur par substrate ke naam ke saath "-ase" laga kar; is bunyad par groups:
1. Proteases (proteins par): pepsin aur trypsin bari polypeptides ko chhoti mein; aminopeptidases chhoti polypeptides ko dipeptides mein; erypsin dipeptides ko amino acids mein torta hai.
2. Lipases (lipids par): pancreatic lipase lipids ko fatty acids aur glycerol mein torta hai.
3. Carbohydrases (carbohydrates par): amylase (starch/amylum, glycogen → maltose); cellulase (cellulose → cellobiose ya glucose); maltase (maltose → glucose); sucrase (sucrose → glucose + fructose); lactase (lactose → glucose + galactose).
4. Nucleases (nucleic acids par): RNAase (RNA), DNAase (DNA), ATPase (ATP).

blocks.prompt:
1. Does physical exercise involve anabolic processes, catabolic processes, or both? Give evidence for your answer.
Kya jismani warzish mein anabolic processes hote hain, catabolic, ya dono? Apne jawab ki daleel dein.
blocks.explanation:
Dono.
Catabolic (pechida molecules ko saada mein torna) warzish ke dauran:
- Muscles respiration mein glucose (aur jama glycogen aur fats) tor kar contraction ke liye ATP ki shakal mein energy nikalte hain.
- Daleel: saans tez aur zyada CO₂ kharij, jism garam aur paseena, aur sakht warzish mein anaerobic respiration se lactic acid jama ho kar thakawat.
Anabolic (saada molecules se pechida banana) warzish ke dauran aur baad:
- ADP + Pi se ATP musalsal dobara banta hai; glucose se glycogen ke zakheere phir bante hain.
- Muscles apni marammat karte aur amino acids se naye proteins banate hain (chapter se aage: baqaida warzish se muscles bare aur mazboot hote hain).
- Daleel: baqaida warzish se muscles barhte aur mazboot hote hain, aur aaram aur khurak ke baad zakheere bhar jate hain.
Yeh sab steps enzymes control karte hain.

blocks.prompt:
2. If a chemical reaction could occur without an enzyme, why is it important to have one?
Agar koi chemical reaction enzyme ke baghair bhi ho sakti hai to enzyme kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation:
1. Raftaar: enzyme ke baghair zyada tar reactions zindagi ke liye bohat dheemi hain. Enzymes activation energy kam kar ke reactions ko 10³ se 10⁸ guna tez karte hain; jo reaction enzyme se 30 minute mein ho woh baghair enzyme aik saal leti.
2. Jism ka temperature: enzymes 37 °C par hi reactions tez chalate hain; inke baghair bohat zyada temperature chahiye jo cell ko tabah kar deta.
3. Specificity: har enzyme sirf apni reaction karwata hai, is liye sahi product sahi jagah banta hai (red blood cells aur nerve cells ke enzymes alag hain).
4. Control: enzymes ka kaam qaabu kiya ja sakta hai (inhibitors, feedback inhibition, pepsinogen jaisi ghair-faal shaklein), is liye metabolism mutawazin rehta hai.
5. Enzyme khud nahi badalta, baar baar istemal hota hai aur products ko nahi badalta.
Is liye enzymes ke baghair zindagi mumkin hi na hoti.

blocks.prompt:
3. Construct and interpret graphs based on data about the effect of temperature, enzyme concentration and substrate concentration on the rate of enzyme action.
Temperature, enzyme concentration aur substrate concentration ke enzyme ki raftaar par asar ke data se graphs banayein aur un ki tashreeh karein.
blocks.explanation:
Graph banana: jo factor badla jaye use x-axis par aur enzyme ke amal ka rate (maslan har minute bana product ya istemal hua substrate) y-axis par units ke saath likhein; har data point plot kar ke hamwar curve se jorein; baqi factors mustaqil rakhein.
1. Temperature ka graph (Fig. 5.5): x-axis temperature (°C). Curve aahista barh kar optimum temperature (insani enzymes 37 °C) par chotti banata hai, phir tezi se girta hai.
Tashreeh: optimum se kam par molecules dheeme aur enzyme kam lachakdar; optimum tak zyada kinetic energy se zyada takraao; is se oopar enzyme denature aur kaam band. Girawat chadhai se zyada tez hai.
2. Enzyme concentration ka graph (Fig. 5.7): x-axis enzyme concentration. Rate seedhi lakeer mein barhta phir hamwar ho jata hai.
Tashreeh: jab tak substrate zyada hai rate enzyme ki miqdaar ke barabar barhta hai; plateau batata hai ke ab substrate kam par gaya.
3. Substrate concentration ka graph (Fig. 5.8): x-axis substrate concentration. Rate pehle tezi se barhta, phir mur kar hamwar ho jata hai.
Tashreeh: kam substrate par bohat si active sites khali, is liye substrate barhane se rate barhta hai; plateau par saari active sites bhari (saturation), ab sirf enzyme barhane se rate barhega.
Aise graphs se optimum, intehai rate aur saturation ka point parha jata hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Kitab is sawal ke liye koi data table nahi deti, is liye yahan graph banane ka tareeqa aur teenon curves ki shakal aur matlab diya gaya hai. Practical mein jo readings milein unhi ko plot karein.

blocks.prompt:
4. Identify the competitive and non-competitive inhibitors from a list of chemicals used in daily life.
Rozmarra istemal hone wale chemicals ki list mein se competitive aur non-competitive inhibitors pehchanein.
blocks.explanation: Competitive inhibitor substrate jaisa ho kar active site gher leta hai; non-competitive kisi aur jagah jur kar enzyme ki shakal badalta hai (cyanide aur heavy metals jaise zehar aksar isi tarah, aksar irreversible).

rows: Malonate (malonic acid): succinic acid jaisa, succinic dehydrogenase ko rokta hai
Cyanide (zehar): cytochrome oxidase ke copper aur iron se jur kar respiration band (irreversible)
Bacteria ke enzyme substrates jaisi antibiotics, maslan sulpha drugs (chapter se aage)
Heavy metal ions jaise lead aur mercury, aaloodah pani ya purane paint mein (chapter se aage)
Penicillin: bacteria ki cell wall banane wale enzyme se jur kar use hamesha ke liye nakara (irreversible)
Cell ke andar zyada ATP aur succinyl-CoA (qudrati, feedback jaisa)
Ethanol, methanol ke zehar ke ilaaj mein, methanol se us ke enzyme ke liye muqabla karta hai (chapter se aage)
Kuch keera maar aur chooha maar dawaon ke arsenic compounds, jo enzyme ki active site se hat kar jurte hain (chapter se aage)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Pehchan ka asool: agar chemical substrate jaisa dikhta hai aur substrate barhane se us ka asar kam hota hai to competitive; agar substrate jaisa nahi aur enzyme ki shakal hi bigar deta hai to non-competitive. Kitab khud cyanide aur penicillin ko irreversible kehti hai; un ki competitive/non-competitive taqseem chapter se aage hai.
